description: This PHP class implements an interface for interacting with the FogBugz REST API within a larger issue tracker integration. It handles establishing connections, fetching issue details, and creating new issues in FogBugz, and includes configuration and auxiliary methods.

classes.name: fogbugzrestInterface
classes.description: A class providing an interface to FogBugz issue tracking system using its REST API, including methods for connection management, issue retrieval, and issue creation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with configuration details, sets up the connection to FogBugz.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes the configuration with default URLs if not provided.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns the API client object after initialization.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks whether the given issue ID has valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the FogBugz server using credentials.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the class is connected to FogBugz.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Fetches details of an issue by its ID from FogBugz.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Retrieves the status code of a specified issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of an issue, in this case the same as status code.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Retrieves the HTML string representing the issue's summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Verifies if an issue with the given ID exists in FogBugz.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in FogBugz with provided summary and description.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template configuration snippet for setting up the FogBugz interface.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates whether issues can be created via the API based on current configuration.
